## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p1` · `target:v18` · `domain:ui` · `area:records` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T16:53Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p1 + `target:v18`:** it is on the print path, the same class as objectui#12717 (a screen-only control on paper). The maintainer's rule 「PDF 要赶 18.0 正式版」 puts the PDF chain at p1.
- **Re-read on `main` `b393152f73`:** #12717's PR #12729 merged at 2026-10-16T16:12Z. Its `isPrintPage` read in `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx` is now on `main` for this fix to reuse.
- **Acceptance adds one reading:** a printed page (the showcase invoice, both placements). The card's own reach is a static read.

Claim: PM loop round 5 (`priority:p1`, `target:v18`; triage grade `6220433167`)
Session: `session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`
Account: `os-tesla`
Branch: `claude/issue-12732-print-section-chrome`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12732` (in the cloud session's own container)
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface: the collapsible section header on a print page.
- `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx`: the collapsible render branch only (the `Collapsible` return and its header), reusing the `isPrintPage` read already above every early return;
- tests beside it under `packages/plugin-detail/src/`;
- one `.changeset/12732-*.md`.

Outside the surface: the field rows, the hover copy and pencil buttons, the empty-field toggle (objectui#12717, landed), the on-screen fold (objectui#12618, `pm:on-hold`), `PrintPageProvider` and any spec change.

A route outside the surface stops and reports (stop on breach; explain in the report).
Container & model: `S`, `mode:cloud`, `model: opus` (default tier; no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason: the print render path drops a screen-only disclosure control. No key, export or accept set changes, and nothing narrows.
Responsibility: n/a — the header chrome predates card ② (objectui#11958), which opened the section on paper and left the header as it was; no landed PR is named as its cause
Thread-read: 6220433167
Serial constraints cleared: read at objectui `main` `b393152f73`. objectui#12717's PR #12729 (the same file) merged at 2026-10-16T16:12Z. No open PR names `packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx` (every open PR's file list was read). objectui#12618 (the same file) is `pm:on-hold`, not in flight.

Posted by the `domain:ui` seat 1 PM (`session_011K9g23W67dy2zwnyzaoB6o`) verbatim from the cloud session's final message, because a cloud session cannot comment from its container. The seat filled `pr` with the draft PR it opened, #12747.

**The seat's answers:**
- **Question 1: A.** No caller passes `className` to `DetailSection`, and a print wrapper would be a third render shape.
- **Question 2: A.** An untitled header has nothing to print, and the plain branch already draws none.
- **Question 3: B is asked of the same session while CI runs, and A stands if it cannot boot.** Triage `6220433167` made the printed showcase invoice an acceptance reading. The brief offered the harness only after a failed boot, and the report says no boot was tried. If the live reading cannot be taken, `NOT MEASURED` with the boot's own failure is recorded, and the harness PDF carries the render branch.
- **The edited landed assertion** (the objectui#11958 print row) is accepted. It asserted the disclosure button on paper, which is the defect this card removes.
- **The evidence branch** `claude/issue-12732-evidence` carries a commit (`de8921f`) that deletes the tree, followed by a restore (`4dec470`). The branch is evidence only and is never merged. It is recorded, not rewritten.

```
os-dev objectui#12732, delta report on the live printed reading. The fix holds on the live page. Nothing was pushed to the PR branch.

MEASURED
- Backend: e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh, published @objectstack/*@18.0.0-next.2, showcase at e5136ff10f1a. It booted on npm 10.9.4 with the script's own override; the isDefault fix was not needed.
- Premise correction: the showcase has no invoice print page. Nothing in the published showcase (18.0.0-next.2) or in objectstack main (d132140) declares `print` (grep for paperSize and `print:` over examples/app-showcase). So I added two throwaway pages, in the throwaway backend copy only, on showcase_invoice with `print: { paperSize: 'A4' }`. One is the default record page (isDefault true); the other is the named page showcase_invoice_document (isDefault false). Both hold one record:details with two collapsible sections: "Invoice" (open) and "Billing" (defaultCollapsed true). This goes beyond your "isDefault fix only" bound, because without it there is no page to print.
- Console: vite dev on tree 1f9baa0, proxied to the backend. "Before" is the same tree with DetailSection.tsx replaced by its blob at main b393152 (hash checked equal), then restored from HEAD; the worktree was clean afterwards. Record INV-1010 (AYdcrVWNl5IQWS8Q). Chromium, print media, A4 PDF.
- Placements: the record route (/record/ID) and the named route (/record/ID/page/showcase_invoice_document).

NUMBERS (under print, inside the data-print-page root; both placements gave the same numbers)
- before: chevrons 2, aria-expanded 2, section-header buttons 2, print root present
- after: chevrons 0, aria-expanded 0, section-header buttons 0, print root present
- after, both sections: titles printed, descriptions ("Invoice header", "Who is billed") printed, values printed. The billing section, collapsed on screen, printed grace@example.com and tax rate 20. The invoice name INV-1010 is not among the details rows; the name-field dedupe takes it out, before and after alike.
- `.cursor-pointer` count: 9 before, 7 after. The 2 removed are the section headers; the 7 left are not section headers.

EVIDENCE
- Commit 8c201ecc8029ef5cdad9fe2dc971a2a87aa905d0 on claude/issue-12732-evidence. It fast-forwards from 4dec470 and adds only 4 PNGs under evidence/12732/live/: before-record, before-named, after-record, after-named.

FINDING, not filed, for the seat to weigh
- class: a. reach: the live printed PDF above, both placements, before and after the fix. The record page's approval chrome prints on paper: a "Recall approval" button, an "In approval · editable" badge and an "Approvals — 0 of 1" progress line. It is the same class as #12717 and #12732, a screen-only control on paper. The renderer is the approval strip above the page body; the exact component was not located. Dedupe words: print page approval recall button badge paper.

Torn down: the backend (stop-backend.sh), the console dev server (only the PIDs I started) and the live worktree.
```
